name.projectionNote: Native TOP line projected using guide frame top + official TextField2px gutter + original SYCN DefineFont3 ascent. Existing Microsoft YaHei glyph rasterization remains offline-only.

projection.scope: Only current logical1080 / n=3 name projection
limits: Offline projection uses existing Microsoft YaHei glyph outlines. It is not a Flash-identical rasterization claim.
The original DefineFont3 ascent is used, not the FFDec-reconstructed TTF hhea.
TOP alignment is preserved; neither box-centering nor a fitted fixed vertical subtraction is used.
Guide fractional box179.75x38.9 is retained as source data; actual UiText constructor ceil is180x39.
Only this verified1080/n3 UI case is represented; no all-count formula is inferred from a screenshot.
